REGYBOX_STATE.description: Created automatically to remember which classes have already been handled.

BOOKING_PLATFORM.description: Booking platform to use: regybox (default) or bookr. Set this text variable to bookr when your box uses Bookr.fit.

PHPSESSID.description: Copy this cookie value from regybox.pt developer tools so the Worker can sign in.

REGYBOX_USER.description: Copy this cookie value from regybox.pt developer tools so the Worker can identify your account.

BOOKR_AUTH_COOKIE.description: Required only when BOOKING_PLATFORM is bookr. Paste only the Bookr Supabase auth cookie pair(s), including every present numbered chunk in order, as a Worker secret; never use a text variable.

CALENDAR_URL.description: Paste the secret iCal address from your Google Calendar settings.

CLASS_MAP.description: Which calendar events book which classes on the selected platform, for example: CrossFit books the WOD class. Separate extra rules with semicolons and add backup class names with commas.

TIMEZONE.description: Timezone used to interpret class times.

LOOKAHEAD_HOURS.description: How many hours ahead the Worker looks for classes.
